facts.fact: Wavemaker's vendor page says a 30-second video costs about 75 credits to generate.
facts.quote: A 30-second clip runs about 75 credits; 60 seconds runs 150.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's vendor page says each edit or refine via chat costs about 15 credits.
facts.quote: Each edit or refine costs about 15 credits, so iterating is cheap.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's vendor page says it offers 21 storyboard presets for mapping scripts to visual plans.
Wavemaker's vendor page says most videos come back in two to five minutes.
facts.quote: Most videos come back in two to five minutes.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's vendor page says custom voice design for voiceovers is available on paid plans.
facts.quote: On paid plans you can design a custom voice to match your brand.

facts.fact: Adwave's free plan gives users 75 credits, which the page says is enough for a first video.
facts.quote: Start on the free plan. You get 75 credits, enough for your first video, so you can learn what good prompts feel like before spending anything.

facts.fact: Each chat refinement in Adwave's video tool costs about 15 credits according to the page.
facts.quote: at about 15 credits per refine, it's cheap to go slowly.

facts.fact: Free-tier Adwave video exports are 480p with a watermark, according to the page.
facts.quote: Free-tier exports come out at 480p with a watermark, which is plenty for testing.

facts.fact: Paid Adwave plans remove the watermark and export video up to 4K, per the page.
facts.quote: Paid plans remove the watermark and export up to 4K.

facts.fact: Adwave states that a completed video can air as a streaming TV commercial on 100+ networks starting from $50.
facts.quote: running on 100+ networks from $50, alongside Google, YouTube, Meta, and Reddit campaigns.

facts.fact: Adwave says most videos are returned within two to five minutes after the idea is submitted.
facts.quote: Most videos come back in two to five minutes after you submit your idea.

facts.fact: Adwave states a roughly 30-second AI video costs about 75 credits.
facts.quote: A roughly 30-second video costs about 75 credits and a 60-second video about 150, with each chat edit running around 15.

facts.fact: Adwave states its paid plans start at $29 per month for more credits, higher resolution, and no watermark.
facts.quote: Paid plans start at $29 a month for more credits, higher resolution, and no watermark.
